counterfactual_missing_items: no explicit optic-disc location or nerve fiber layer defect
no inferior or embryonic-fissure coloboma distribution with iris coloboma
no diffuse posterior staphyloma or broader myopic maculopathy description
decisive_items: a focal scleral ectasia with no overlying retina
The sclera was approximately one-third thinner
response.rationale: R3 is directly supported by the raw OCT finding of a focal scleral ectasia with absent overlying retina, focal scleral thinning, and obliterated choroid, matching the pit-like lesion described. R1 supplies only the high-myopia background (axial length, chorioretinal atrophy) and lacks the specific focal ectasia lesion identity. R2 and R4 are rejected because the lesion is neither located at the optic disc nor distributed as a congenital embryonic-fissure coloboma.

rejected.why: Choroidal coloboma would require congenital embryonic-fissure location and typical colobomatous features; here the lesion is a focal acquired scleral ectasia within myopic chorioretinal atrophy.

Optic Disc Pit is not supported because the raw findings locate the pit in the posterior sclera with choroidal obliteration and do not describe an optic-disc-site lesion or characteristic nerve fiber layer findings.
